records.title: MDPO: Overcoming the Training-Inference Divide of Masked Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 MDPO trains masked diffusion language models to close the training/inference gap. The method is focused on diffusion-language-model training and sampling; the reviewed paper does not establish a general autoregressive LLM serving or KV-cache optimization, so the lineage link is weak.

records.title: A Foundation Model for Lesion Segmentation on Brain MRI With Mixture of Modality Experts
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 MoME assigns image-modality expertise with hierarchical gating; MoME+ adds soft input routing for missing/combined MRI modalities. It evaluates nine lesion datasets and reports performance comparable to multiple task-specific nnU-Nets with simpler model management/deployment. This is medical segmentation rather than LLM expert parallelism or inference serving, so the MoE-family connection is conceptual.

records.title: When One LLM Drools, Multi-LLM Collaboration Rules
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 This position paper surveys multi-LLM collaboration across API/text/logit/weight levels and discusses cost-aware model selection and cascade tradeoffs. It contributes taxonomy and directions, not a new measured routing/serving algorithm; API cascades can add cost/latency.
